CustomField.description: Rich-text body of the delete-confirmation modal on Table sections, passed as delete-modal-body to c-flow-data-table. Use it to warn the user before a row is removed. Applies only to Table component types when Enable Delete Action is checked.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The message inside the delete-confirmation popup, such as a warning that the row cannot be recovered. Applies to Tables only and requires Enable Delete Action.
CustomField.label: Modal Body Text
